title: 第11章 勇者无敌第12章 来自二小姐的召唤

第11章 勇者无敌
摊上这么一个职业导师，刘烨不仅感叹福祸相依，等那一天自己牛叉了，第一件事情就是从这老家伙手里把金币全都抢回来！
剑痴老大这边，看到刘烨离开，脸上露出满意之色，手握一大把金币，大摇大摆的走进云香酒馆，“李二狗，快把九粮液的库存都搬出来，今天大爷我不醉不归！”
“呦，剑爷的骗术真高，我这就给你去准备！”酒馆老板看到明晃晃的金币，急忙赔笑一声，带着一群手下冲向酒窖。
此时的酒馆里有很多无聊的玩家，看到如此煞风景的情况，纷纷厌恶的离开了。
…………
话说刘烨离开落日城以后，直接朝着郊外的练级区开进，一天的时间已经过去大半，关于寻找拜亚帝国的任务，刘烨想多准备一些日子，因为这个任务并不简单。
按照自己的游戏经验，刘烨很快便找到一处适合自己练级的地方，这片空旷的地图是落日城居民的大牧场，生活着许多15级怪物，以自己如今的实力，越级杀怪已经是很简单的事情了！
远远便看到一头黑白相间的奶牛游荡在草场中，刘烨凝眉一笑，开启御剑术，手中的鬼王剑绽放出淡蓝色的幽光，瞬间脱手而出，化作一道天蓝色的光影。
“帅气啊！”刘烨忍不住高呼一声，御剑术目前只能持续5秒的时间，急忙催动鬼王剑刺向奶牛，“嗤——！”
“－115”
“－109”
“暴击－221”
“－113”
一连串的伤害从奶牛头顶飘起，5秒的时间，御剑术竟然做出了9次攻击，果然不愧是攻速+1的技能，相当的牛叉。
小奶牛经过御剑术的摧残以后，已经变成残血，来到跟班二号面前，被跟班二号一个剑气斩直接撂倒！
系统提示：杀死狂暴的奶牛－15级，获得经验450点。
“可惜冷却时间太长了些！”
幽幽的感叹一声，刘烨开始了漫无目的的刷怪，剑气斩+冲锋+御剑术，只三个新技能只要冷却一过，刘烨就会直接使用出来，这样既可以获得经验，又可以把技能熟练度提升上去。
好在刘烨背包里的中瓶蓝药还有很多，从中午一直到下午，刘烨都保持在枯燥的刷怪状态，直到系统提示三个新技能全都升到10级，刘烨才停止手中的攻击！

跟班二号的等级也在刷怪中提升到了11级，的位置已经岌岌可危：
1.剑红尘（剑客－12级）
2.月下独赏（法师－12级）
3.黑武士（斗士－12级）
4.鬼谷子（刺客－12级）
5.神格意志（智士－12级）
6.葵花宝典（猎杀者－12级）
7.吸血鬼宝宝（巫师－12级）
8.暗淡月光（弓箭手－12级）
9.神话轩轩（剑客－12级）
10.九玄月（法师－12级）
…………
等级榜第一页一共五十名玩家，清一色的12级，这让刘烨汗颜不已，好在重生之后自己行事变得低调了许多。
仔细观看今天的等级榜前十，经历了一天沉淀以后，终于找到了几个老熟人，正是排在第六位的隐藏职业猎杀者——葵花宝典！
此人对于刺客职业的操作绝对是一流的，特别是获得隐藏职业猎杀者以后，就算是自己遇到都会头疼。
除此之外，就是玄月MM了，一天不见，这丫头已经冲到了12级，真是个疯狂的女人，在刘烨的印象里，林玄月对自己的家族集团忠心耿耿，如果不是因为她的存在，整个中锋集团早已不复存在了！
关闭等级榜，刘烨的眼中闪过一丝落寞，自己的本尊还在没命的练级、找任务吧？
增强，其中最明显的就是御剑术了，除此之外，其他技能都有相应提高：
【剑气斩】（攻击技能）
消耗：60点魔法值

效果：凝聚一道蓝色剑气，在身前挥出强有力的一剑，造成150%物理伤害+100%魔法伤害。
冷却：7秒
释放距离：6米
【冲锋】（限制技能）
消耗：68点魔法值
效果：激发剑客潜能，瞬间爆发出来，对前方电梯目标发出强有力的冲撞，造成80%物理伤害，使目标陷入2秒眩晕状态。
冷却：25秒
释放距离：9米
【御剑术】（攻击技能）
消耗：100点魔法值
效果：九世剑修招牌技能，隔空驾驭飞剑，可以随意操纵飞剑攻击身前目标，攻速+2，持续8秒，造成90%物理伤害+70%魔法伤害。
冷却：55秒
释放距离：18米
满意的点点头，正当刘烨准备离开落日城牧场的时候，不远处忽然间传来了嘈杂的打斗声，刘烨立刻来了兴趣，小心翼翼的潜伏过去。
只见一片绿油油的草地上，两队人马正在疯狂的厮杀着，其中竟然有两个熟人，就是上次被自己挂掉的等级榜法师见钱眼开，另一个是云香酒馆遇到的好心壮汉勇者无敌！
双方的队伍都是五个人，勇者无敌的技术还算可以，和见钱眼开等人厮杀起来勇猛无比，绝对是一员猛将，至于见钱眼开这边，除了上次的骑士圣火以外，其他的玩家都不怎么样。
很快的，勇者无敌的队伍已经占据上峰，见钱眼开这边被挂掉一个人！
“哪里来的散人，敢得罪我们东风再起？！”见钱眼开脸色难看的叫嚷着，法杖上火苗蹿动，射出一颗人头大小的大火球术。
勇者无敌勇往无前，硬抗下见钱眼开的攻击，冲过去一个下段踢将他撂倒，硕大的拳头劈头盖脸而去，“东风再起怎么了？打的就是你们这些富二代！”
“勇哥，大力点！大力点！”另一边的战圈里，勇者无敌的队友楚留香兴奋的高呼着。

“小刘放心，绝对够力！”勇者无敌爽朗大笑一声，直接骑在见钱眼开肚皮上，一双闪着蓝光的拳头疯狂下落。
只看到一连串的伤害数字从见钱眼开头顶升起，血条直线掉落，“**是谁？本少爷跟你没完！没完！”
下一刻，见钱眼开的哀号声戛然而止，再也没有起来，只见勇者无敌意犹未尽的砸了一拳头，朝着余下的三名东风再起玩家杀过去。
“老大~~~！”看到自己老大惨死，东风再起的玩家爆发出前所未有的力量，竟然将勇者无敌等五个人压制住了。
刘烨看的津津有味，只是没想到见钱眼开竟然是东风再起的人，看样子自己昨天下手轻了，应该把他杀回零级，“东风再起，有哥在，你们就等着**吧！”
这个时候，战斗变得更加惨烈起来，只见圣火双眼通红，一个挑衅砸在勇者无敌身上，勇者无敌被迫向他移动过来，同时一道重剑斩砸了过去。
砰——“－108”
勇者无敌的头顶飘起一道巨大的伤害，脸色难看下来，斗士这个职业物理攻击强横，爆发力牛叉，但是生命值少的可怜，这一下加上之前的大火球术，直接将他打成残血。
“勇哥！”旁边的玩家见状，急忙朝圣火杀过去。
“去死吧！”圣火目露疯狂之色，手中的重剑狠狠地朝着勇者无敌砍过去，在他看来，只要这一剑下去，勇者无敌绝对挂掉了。
可是令他万万没有想到的是，就在他刚刚举起重剑的一瞬间，一股大力从身后震荡而来，系统提示：受到玩家（跟班二号）攻击，失去87点生命，进入眩晕状态，持续2秒！
刘烨冷笑着出现在圣火背后，怒斩+剑气斩直接打空了他的生命条，不明所以的圣火就这样倒下了。

Chapter 11 The Brave is Invincible
With such a professional mentor, Liu Ye not only lamented that blessings and misfortunes depended on each other, but when the day came that he became a master, the first thing he would do was to snatch all the gold coins back from this old guy!
The boss of Jian Chi saw Liu Ye leaving with a look of satisfaction on his face. Holding a large handful of gold coins, he swaggered into Yunxiang Tavern and said, "Li Ergou, quickly move out all the inventory of Jiuliangye. I will not return until I'm drunk today!"
"Hey, Mr. Jian's deception is really good. I'll prepare it for you right now!" The tavern owner saw the gleaming gold coins and hurriedly laughed in apology, then rushed towards the wine cellar with a group of his men.
There were many bored players in the tavern at this time. Seeing such a disgraceful situation, they all left in disgust.
…………
It is said that after Liu Ye left Sunset City, he drove directly towards the leveling area in the suburbs. Most of the day had passed. Regarding the task of finding the Baiya Empire, Liu Ye wanted to prepare for a few more days, because this task was not simple.
According to his own game experience, Liu Ye quickly found a place suitable for him to level up. This empty map is a large pasture for the residents of Sunset City. There are many level 15 monsters living there. With his current strength, it is very simple to kill monsters beyond the level!
From a distance, he saw a black and white cow wandering in the pasture. Liu Ye frowned and smiled, and activated the sword control technique. The Ghost King Sword in his hand bloomed with a light blue light, and he took it out instantly, turning into a sky blue light and shadow.
"How handsome!" Liu Ye couldn't help shouting. The sword control technique can only last for 5 seconds at present, so he hurriedly activated the Ghost King Sword to stab the cow, "Hi——!"
"-115"
"-109"
"Crit-221"
"-113"
A series of damage floated from the top of the cow's head. In 5 seconds, Sword Control actually made 9 attacks. It was indeed a skill with +1 attack speed, which was quite awesome.
After being tortured by the swordsmanship, the little cow had reduced its health to residual blood. When it came to Follower No. 2, it was knocked down by Follower No. 2's sword energy!
System prompt: Kill the furious cow - Level 15, gain 450 experience points.
"It's a pity that the cooling time is too long!"
With a faint sigh, Liu Ye began to aimlessly clear monsters, using Sword Qi Slash + Charge + Sword Control. As soon as the three new skills were cooled down, Liu Ye would use them directly. In this way, he could not only gain experience, but also improve his skill proficiency.
Fortunately, Liu Ye still had a lot of blue medicine in his backpack. From noon to the afternoon, Liu Ye remained in a boring state of spawning monsters. It was not until the system prompted that all three new skills had been upgraded to level 10 that Liu Ye stopped attacking!
The level of Follower No. 2 has also been raised to level 11 during the monster spawning process, and his position is already in jeopardy:
1. Jian Hongchen (Swordsman - Level 12)
2. Solitary reward under the moon (Mage - Level 12)
3.Dark Warrior (Fighter - Level 12)
4. Guiguzi (Assassin - Level 12)
5. Divine Will (Wise Man - Level 12)
6. Sunflower Book (Hunter - Level 12)
7. Vampire Baby (Wizard - Level 12)
8. Dim Moonlight (Archer-Level 12)
9. Myth Xuanxuan (Swordsman - Level 12)
10. Jiuxuanyue (Mage - Level 12)
…………
There were a total of fifty players on the first page of the level list, all of whom were level 12. This made Liu Ye ashamed. Fortunately, after his rebirth, he became much more low-key.
Carefully look at the top ten of today's level list. After a day of settling down, I finally found a few old acquaintances. It was the hidden professional hunter ranked sixth - Sunflower Collection!
This person's operation of the assassin profession is absolutely top-notch, especially after obtaining the hidden professional hunter, even if he encounters it himself, he will have a headache.
Apart from that, it’s MM Xuan Yue. I haven’t seen you for a day, and this girl has already reached level 12. It’s reallyA crazy woman, in Liu Ye's impression, Lin Xuanyue was loyal to her family group. If it weren't for her existence, the entire Center Group would have ceased to exist!
After closing the level list, a trace of loneliness flashed in Liu Ye's eyes. His true self was still leveling up and looking for quests, right?
Enhancements, the most obvious of which is sword control. In addition, other skills have been improved accordingly:
[Sword Qi Slash] (attack skill)
Cost: 60 magic points
Effect: Condensing a blue sword energy, swinging a powerful sword in front of the body, causing 150% physical damage + 100% magic damage.
Cooldown: 7 seconds
Release distance: 6 meters
[Charge] (limited skill)
Cost: 68 magic points
Effect: Stimulates the potential of the swordsman, bursts out instantly, and makes a powerful collision with the target in the elevator in front, causing 80% physical damage and making the target stun for 2 seconds.
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Release distance: 9 meters
【Sword Control】(Attack Skill)
Cost: 100 magic points
Effect: Ninth World Sword Master's signature skill is to control flying swords in the air. You can control flying swords to attack the target in front of you at will. Attack speed +2, lasts for 8 seconds, causing 90% physical damage + 70% magic damage.
Cooldown: 55 seconds
Release distance: 18 meters
Nodding with satisfaction, just as Liu Ye was about to leave the Sunset City Ranch, a noisy fighting sound suddenly came from not far away. Liu Ye immediately became interested and lurked over cautiously.
On a piece of green grass, two teams of people were fighting crazily. There were actually two acquaintances among them, the mage on the level list who was killed by him last time. The other one was the kind-hearted and strong man Invincible who met in Yunxiang Tavern!
There are only five people in the team on both sides. The skills of Brave Invincible are pretty good. They are very brave when fighting with Jianqianyankai and others. They are definitely a strong general. As for Jianqianyankai, except for the Knight's Holy Fire last time, the other players are not very good.
Soon, the brave and invincible team had already occupied the top. Seeing the money, one person was killed here!
"Where are the San people who dare to offend us? Dongfeng Rises Again?!" Seeing Qian's eyes wide open, he shouted with an ugly face. The flames on the staff jumped and shot out a big fireball the size of a human head.
The brave man is invincible and moves forward bravely. He resists Qian's attack, rushes over and knocks him down with a low kick, and hits his head and face with his huge fist, "What's wrong with Dongfeng Rises? I'm beating you rich second generation!"
"Brother Yong, work harder! Work harder!" On the other side of the battle circle, Chu Liuxiang, the teammate of Invincible Brave, shouted excitedly.
"Don't worry, Xiao Liu, it's definitely powerful enough!" Brave Man Invincible laughed heartily, directly riding on the belly of Jianqian Yankai, and a pair of fists flashing with blue light fell crazily.
I only saw a series of damage figures rising from the top of Jian Qianyan's head, and the blood bar dropped straight, "Who is this? I am not done with you! I am not done with you!"
The next moment, the wailing sound of Qian Yan suddenly stopped and never got up again. The brave man punched his fist without any hostility and killed the remaining three Dongfeng Rises players.
"Boss~~~!" Seeing the tragic death of their boss, the players from Dongfeng Rising burst out with unprecedented strength and suppressed the Brave Invincible and five other people.
Liu Ye looked at it with great interest, but he didn't expect that Qian Qianqian would turn out to be the person from Dongfeng Uprising. It seemed that he acted lightly yesterday and should kill him back to level zero. "Dongfeng Uprising, brother is here, you just wait and die!"
At this time, the battle became more fierce. I saw the eyes of the holy fire were red, and a provocation hit the brave invincible. The brave invincible was forced to move towards him, and at the same time, a heavy sword slashed over him.
Bang——“-108”
A huge damage appeared above the head of the brave warrior, and his face turned ugly. The fighter is a profession with strong physical attacks.He had great explosive power, but his health was pitiful. This time, coupled with the previous fireball technique, he was beaten to the lowest level of health.
"Brother Yong!" Upon seeing this, the player next to him hurriedly rushed towards the holy fire.
"Go to hell!" Sheng Huo's eyes showed a crazy look, and the heavy sword in his hand slashed hard at the Brave Invincible. In his opinion, as long as this sword was struck, the Brave Invincible would definitely die.
But what he never expected was that just as he raised the heavy sword, a powerful force came from behind. The system prompted: He was attacked by the player (Follower No. 2) and lost 87 points of life. He entered a dizzy state that lasted for 2 seconds!
Liu Ye appeared behind the Holy Fire with a sneer, and slashed with anger + sword energy to directly empty his life bar, and the Holy Fire fell down without knowing why.
